label: Foundations
lead: The decisions every component is built from: color, type, space, shape, depth and motion, each one a design token.

label: Components
lead: {count} accessible React components, each with its states, props, tokens and a usage guide.

label: Patterns
lead: Whole screens and flows built from the components, ready to copy: sign-in, checkout, settings, dashboards.

label: Blocks
lead: Sections of a page, bigger than a component and smaller than a screen: a pricing table, a page header, an FAQ.

label: Guides
lead: How the components work together for the jobs every app has: forms, feedback, loading, destructive actions.
